description: Circular-shift control testing whether spatial clustering of conserved exposed residues survives correction for sequence contiguity
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
human=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')
def lu(s):
    cs=[i for i,c in enumerate(s) if c=='C']
    if len(cs)<10: return None
    cs=cs[-10:]
    if [cs[i+1]-cs[i] for i in range(9)]!=[3,9,7,8,18,4,16,1,6]: return None
    if cs[0]-4<0 or cs[-1]+4>len(s): return None
    return s[cs[0]-4:cs[-1]+4], cs[0]-4
hdom,hoff=lu(human); HSTART=hoff+1
txt=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={'query':'(gene:ACRV1) AND (taxonomy_id:40674)','format':'fasta','size':500},timeout=120).text
seen={}
for blk in txt.split('>')[1:]:
    h,s=blk.split('\n',1); s=s.replace('\n','')
    org=re.search(r'OS=(.+?) OX=',h); org=org.group(1) if org else '?'
    v=lu(s)
    if v and len(v[0])==len(hdom): seen.setdefault(org,v[0])
aln=np.array([list(v) for v in seen.values()]); NSP=len(aln)
ent=np.array([-(lambda p:(p*np.log2(p)).sum())(np.unique(aln[:,j],return_counts=True)[1]/NSP) for j in range(80)])
cons=1-ent/np.log2(20)
pdb=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P26436-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for l in pdb.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        rn=int(l[22:26])
        if HSTART<=rn<=HSTART+79: rows.append((rn,(l[76:78].strip() or 'C'),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['res','el','x','y','z'])
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}; r=at.el.map(RAD).fillna(1.7).values
X=at[['x','y','z']].values; PR=1.4
k=np.arange(200)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*k/200); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k
U=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2); sasa=np.zeros(len(X))
for i in range(len(X)):
    Ri=r[i]+PR; pts=X[i]+Ri*U; acc=np.ones(200,bool)
    for j in np.where((D[i]<Ri+r+PR)&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]:
        acc &= np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=r[j]+PR
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*Ri**2*acc.mean()
at['sasa']=sasa
MAX={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
     'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
df=pd.DataFrame({'res':np.arange(HSTART,HSTART+80),'aa':list(hdom),'cons':cons})
df['rsasa']=df.res.map(at.groupby('res').sasa.sum()).values/df.aa.map(MAX)
cen=at.groupby('res')[['x','y','z']].mean(); df[['cx','cy','cz']]=cen.loc[df.res].values
df['exposed']=df.rsasa>0.25
exp=df[df.exposed].reset_index(drop=True); C=exp[['cx','cy','cz']].values
def mpd(idx):
    P=C[idx]; d=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None],axis=2); return d[np.triu_indices(len(idx),1)].mean()
hit=exp.index[exp.cons>=0.95].to_numpy(); n=len(hit); obs=mpd(hit)

# ---- CONTROL 1: free permutation (as before) ----
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null_free=np.array([mpd(rng.choice(len(exp),n,replace=False)) for _ in range(20000)])
# ---- CONTROL 2: circular shift, preserves sequence contiguity of the conserved set ----
null_shift=[]
for s in range(1,80):
    cs_=np.roll(cons,s)
    ex=df.exposed.values
    ordr=np.argsort(-cs_[ex])          # top-n exposed positions under shifted conservation
    null_shift.append(mpd(ordr[:n]))
null_shift=np.array(null_shift)
p_shift=(null_shift<=obs).mean()
print("observed mean pairwise distance of the 20 conserved-exposed residues: %.2f A"%obs)
print("CONTROL 1 free permutation : null %.2f +/- %.2f , p=%.4f"%(null_free.mean(),null_free.std(),(null_free<=obs).mean()))
print("CONTROL 2 circular shift   : null %.2f +/- %.2f , p=%.3f  (79 shifts, resolution 0.013)"%(
      null_shift.mean(),null_shift.std(),p_shift))
print("shifted values <= obs: %d of 79"%(null_shift<=obs).sum())

# ---- how anisotropic is the patch? fraction of domain surface it covers ----
allc=df[['cx','cy','cz']].values; ctr=allc.mean(0)
v=df[['cx','cy','cz']].values-ctr; v=v/np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1,keepdims=True)
pv=v[df.index[(df.exposed)&(df.cons>=0.95)]]
mean_dir=pv.mean(0); mean_dir/=np.linalg.norm(mean_dir)
ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(pv@mean_dir,-1,1)))
ang_all=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(v[df.index[df.exposed]]@mean_dir,-1,1)))
print("\nangular spread about patch centroid direction: conserved-exposed mean %.0f deg (max %.0f); all exposed mean %.0f deg"%(
      ang.mean(),ang.max(),ang_all.mean()))
print("conserved-exposed residues within 90 deg of patch direction: %d/%d ; all exposed: %d/%d"%(
      (ang<90).sum(),len(ang),(ang_all<90).sum(),len(ang_all)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6))
ax[0].hist(null_free,bins=60,color='lightsteelblue',density=True,label='free permutation')
ax[0].hist(null_shift,bins=20,color='darkseagreen',density=True,alpha=.75,label='circular shift')
ax[0].axvline(obs,c='crimson',lw=2,label='observed')
ax[0].set_xlabel('mean pairwise distance (A)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('density'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title('Clustering of conserved exposed residues\nsurvives free permutation, fails the contiguity control')
sc=ax[1].scatter(df.cx,df.cy,c=df.cons,cmap='viridis',s=60+260*df.rsasa,vmin=.6,vmax=1)
m=(df.exposed)&(df.cons>=.95)
ax[1].scatter(df.cx[m],df.cy[m],facecolors='none',edgecolors='crimson',s=200,lw=1.6)
plt.colorbar(sc,ax=ax[1],label='conservation')
ax[1].set_xlabel('x (A)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('y (A)')
ax[1].set_title('ACRV1 186-265, size = exposure\nred rings = invariant and exposed')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
